issue.description:
ADR-002 replaces cross-tool import adapters with agent-guided rehydration whose deliverable is a reconciliation report mapping every source identifier to a native identifier or an explicit omitted/merged/unresolved disposition, recording the source repository and commit, and explicitly never accepted as native store input. Nothing in the supplied docs defines the report's schema, validation rules, or a worked example, nor the batching and resumability ADR-002 says large repositories need. Write the report specification and fixtures and document how a rehydration run is reviewed, so reports are consistent across agents and auditable while remaining non-native.

issue.close_reason:
Sharded retained-checkpoint selectors counted record indexes within one shard file (checkpoint:<gen>:record:<n>), so the same secret text at the same record index in two shards produced one shared fingerprint; find_retained_checkpoint_finding then failed with "one secret fingerprint resolved to multiple checkpoint records" (surfaced as "could not scan retained checkpoint redaction targets"), breaking redact --finding for those retained findings and collapsing distinct copies into one fingerprint in doctor output.

Fix (1b310694): both the diagnostic scan (scan_jsonl via scan_shard_manifest) and the retained lookup (find_checkpoint_issues_in_jsonl via checkpoint_issue_paths) now build their record selector through one shared checkpoint_record_selector helper. Sharded records carry their manifest path (checkpoint:<gen>:<shard>:record:<n>); monolithic roots keep the historical checkpoint:<gen>:record:<n> shape. The helper is the single construction point, so the fingerprint doctor prints always matches what redact resolves. Receipts persist only the live semantic origin identity and acknowledgements apply only to live scans, so no persisted selector format changes and no version bump is needed; no code parses the selector shape (verified across src, tests, and the release scripts - the only consumers are starts_with("checkpoint:") classification checks). The stale cross-shard collision clause in the redact --all-blocking deferral comment now cites this fix.

Tests: identical_text_in_two_shards_yields_distinct_resolvable_findings asserts two distinct fingerprints with shard-qualified selectors, per-finding resolution to its own issue record, and a clean two-entry batch resolution (the --all-blocking path); monolithic_retained_selectors_keep_the_record_only_shape pins the unchanged monolithic selector and resolution. Mutation control: reverting the helper to the record-only shape failed the new test at the fingerprint-collision assertion, then was restored byte-for-byte. Commit 90124189 updates retained_checkpoint_issue_fingerprint_redacts_live_description, whose sharded half asserted the old shape: it now pins the generation via the checkpoint: prefix plus :record: and additionally requires a shard path (objects/) in sharded mode while keeping the exact record-only shape for monolithic; that full integration file passes 10/10, covering bead redact --finding on a retained fingerprint end-to-end in both modes.

Checklist: pre-staging git status reviewed; only this task's three files were staged (src/service/secret_diagnostics.rs, src/service/redaction.rs, tests/redaction_publication.rs); every other dirty file predates the dispatch and was left untouched. Verified the committed state, not the working tree: git archive of HEAD 90124189 into /data/build/scratch/beadrs-4b5ee36b-verify-JykPqP, where scripts/definition-of-done.sh ran to completion (PASS: fmt + clippy + test, exit 0; zero FAILED/panicked lines in its log) and the two acceptance cargo test lines were re-run with a private target directory; the extraction and its gate target directory were removed after success. Two earlier background starts of the same script were stopped by the harness 600-second background time limit mid-suite and were restarted; the final complete run is the evidence here. git push exit=0 (1690e1de..90124189); git rev-list origin/main..HEAD exit=0 with empty output.

```verified:
scripts/definition-of-done.sh exit=0
cargo fmt --check exit=0
cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings exit=0
cargo test exit=0
cargo test --lib service::secret_diagnostics exit=0
cargo test --test redaction_publication exit=0
```
issue.description: Found 2026-10-07 (beadrs-10b5d471 follow-up). In sharded mode, retained-checkpoint findings carry selector checkpoint:<gen>:record:<n> where n is the line index within ONE shard file, and the fingerprint covers (ruleset, rule, selector, field, range, bytes). The same secret text at the same record index in two shards yields identical fingerprints, and secret_diagnostics::find_retained_checkpoint_finding errors 'one secret fingerprint resolved to multiple checkpoint records' (surfaced as 'could not scan retained checkpoint redaction targets'). Repro: sharded store, 6-8 beads with identical description text containing a secret. Consequences: (1) bead redact --finding <fp> for such a retained finding fails; (2) doctor output collapses distinct copies into one fingerprint. --all-blocking is mitigated by beadrs-10b5d471 (retained findings that fail to resolve are deferred; post-publication inventory proves nothing remains). Fix: include the shard identity (object path or shard key) in the retained selector, e.g. checkpoint:<gen>:<shard>:record:<n>, keeping monolithic selectors unchanged; bump whatever version pins selector format if any receipts persist it. Acceptance: two shards with the same secret at the same index produce distinct fingerprints; redact --finding on each resolves exactly one record; monolithic selectors unchanged; tests in both modes; fmt/clippy/test green.
issue.notes: Delivered on main: 1b310694 (fix: shard-qualified retained-checkpoint selectors via one shared checkpoint_record_selector helper; monolithic shape unchanged; two unit tests; mutation control confirmed the new test fails against the old selector shape) and 90124189 (test: redaction_publication sharded assertion accepts shard-qualified selectors and requires an objects/ shard path in sharded mode, record-only exactness kept for monolithic). Definition of done (fmt, clippy --all-targets, full cargo test) passed exit=0 in a git-archive extraction of pushed HEAD 90124189; acceptance lines cargo test --lib service::secret_diagnostics (9 passed) and cargo test --test redaction_publication (10 passed) exit=0 in the same extraction with a private target dir. Pushed 1690e1de..90124189; git rev-list origin/main..HEAD empty. Extraction removed after verification.
issue.title: Retained-checkpoint finding selectors collide across issue shards (record:<n> counts per shard)

issue.close_reason: ref add and ref remove now append one audit event in their own transaction (external_ref_added / external_ref_removed) with namespace and key in the detail. Values are never recorded verbatim — only a SHA-256 fingerprint — since R011 values are free-form and can carry a credential-shaped string. Events are gated on semantic change: an identical re-add (upsert no-op) and a remove that deletes nothing append nothing; a changed-value re-add does append. Unit + CLI tests cover event shape, redaction, no-ops, and per-mutation advance of `bead changes --latest`; full cargo test green (685 passed). Shipped in faae4b7.
